session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Vacuum Selloff to Trading Range Bull Breakout'. Weak bull wedge rally into a trading range high after an extended bull trend, failed bull breakout, and a vacuum selloff bar 12 to the support cluster (bar 12 close, 50% retrace yesterday ETH, Daily RTH EMA); higher low double bottom and 2nd leg bear trap turned bulls into a tight bull channel in the form of a small pullback bull trend to hit 50% retrace (HR Yesterday's Range) overnight, close 7622.
